sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Preserve the prior interpolation repair: the single coherent calculation-case interpolation collection and five paired anchors are correctly represented, and the ship/hull-case owners, operands, result, relationships, datatypes, and units remain appropriate. The candidate still omits the explicitly required stated linear-interpolation method/reference on the calculation case. Locate the canonical method term or controlled value and add the required calculation-case link with appropriate cardinality; do not invent a term or execute the nonlinear formula under COMPLEX_READINESS.
